policy: Canonical network identity and verifier configuration must be registered before a bridge route can qualify an Exchange asset.

V12.5.6.note: The preserved XRP design from V12.5.6 was requalified on current main under V12.5.15 using modular adapter CI without the obsolete diagnostic workflow changes.

V12.5.8.note: AUDIO is qualified as the canonical Ethereum ERC-20 asset using EthereumBridgeAdapter420.

V12.5.9.note: POT bridges directly to native PotCoin mainnet; the Solana SPL representation is not the canonical V12.5.9 route.

V12.5.10.note: BOB bridges directly to Dobbscoin mainnet with 2026 LWMA/emergency-difficulty rules and scheduled AuxPoW activation modeled in the verifier boundary.

V12.5.11.note: CURE bridges directly to Curecoin mainnet. PoS chain finality and transaction inclusion are verified independently of Folding at Home research-reward accounting.

V12.5.12.note: ARRR uses a shielded-note verifier boundary with dPoW notarization and authorized viewing-key evidence; transparent user transfer assumptions are explicitly rejected.

V12.5.13.note: LTC bridges directly to Litecoin mainnet with scrypt PoW/chainwork verification and standard legacy/SegWit/Taproot output support. MWEB is excluded from the Genesis route pending dedicated qualification.

V12.5.14.note: BTC bridges directly to Bitcoin mainnet with SHA-256d PoW/cumulative-chainwork verification, six-confirmation bridge policy, replay protection and standard legacy/SegWit/Taproot output support.

V12.5.15.note: XRP was requalified on current main with validated-ledger and tesSUCCESS requirements, AccountID allowlisting, destination-tag encoding and replay protection under modular adapter CI.

V12.5.16.note: UNI qualifies the canonical Ethereum ERC-20 contract over EthereumBridgeAdapter420 with exact source-token mapping, route binding, Ethereum finality, gateway authorization and replay protection.

note: Non-EVM routeChainId values are internal canonical bridge identifiers. Exact network fingerprints and verifier parameters are pinned during each adapter implementation slice rather than guessed in this catalogue.
